## Source anomalies found in Phase 2


1. **Charlotte printed in two conferences.** Charlotte appears in both the American (p. 49) and Conference USA (p. 187) projected standings tables with identical figures. Its own team page (p. 52) and every Conference USA team page ('#N of 10') place it in the American. Treated as a duplicate printing in the Conference USA table.


2. **Mislabelled prediction row on p. 4.** A row printed under `SUN BELT CHAMP` holds 22 picks that are almost all NFL teams (Falcons, Panthers, Buccaneers, Saints — the NFC South), with a single college entry (James Madison) among them. The label does not describe the contents. Verified against the page geometry at several row tolerances, all of which return the same 22 entries, so this is how the guide is printed rather than an extraction artifact. The row is excluded from conference prediction data and recorded here as printed.


3. **`MWC CCHAMPION`** — the Mountain West row on p. 4 is printed with a doubled C. Reproduced as printed.


4. **Coach tenure stated inconsistently** in 1 case(s), where a preview essay and a team page give different season numbers for the same coach. Both figures are kept:


   - **Brian Newberry (Navy Midshipmen)** — preview says season 4, team page (p. 60) says 5.
